metaDescription: Convert YAML (maps, lists, anchors, multi-line strings) to TOML tables and arrays of tables. Null values are rejected as TOML has none.
intro: Move configuration from YAML to TOML in one step.
why:
The YAML is parsed (including anchors, merge keys and block scalars) and written as TOML with tables, nested tables and arrays of tables. Because TOML has no null and requires a table at the top level, those cases are reported rather than silently altered. Mixed-type arrays are allowed in modern TOML.

Comments are not carried over, since the conversion goes through data. Check dates and numbers after conversion.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Review tables and arrays of tables.
